arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Hallward-Driemeier argued the statute text supports a six-year limit.
Mr. Hurt stated the statutory text clearly requires a six-year limit.
Justice Stevens questioned if retaliation victims often bring qui tam actions.
Justice Breyer noted the broad business support for the district's position.
